{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f'Number of QA orders: {qa_mask.sum()}')

# Filter out QA orders and refunded orders
completed_non_qa = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & ~qa_mask]

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA)
mean_revenue_completed = completed_non_qa['revenue_clean'].mean()

print(f'Mean revenue of completed orders (excluding QA): {mean_revenue_completed}')

# Output the final value
print(mean_revenue_completed)"}
